purpose: Preserve the approved orthographic facts while leaving undecided lexical questions explicitly unknown.

surface.rule: The exact pointed source form and its exact source range are always preserved.

hyphen_connectors.rule: A hyphen connector internal to a non-whitespace span joins one orthographic unit.

initialisms.rule: An acronym or initialism containing internal quote marks remains one orthographic unit.

attached_prefixes.repetition_rule: Counts must be reported separately for each representation and must identify the representation used.
attached_prefixes.classification_rule: Every classification must identify the representation and segmentation rule used.

numbers_and_verse_markers.question: Which occurrences are words and which are structural markers?
